content.text:
## 1. In-game `/proposal` — none today

No Minecraft slash/command named `proposal` in root-play, root-ops, or rootmc.

| What exists | Path / symbol |
|---|---|
| Nation founding only | `Plugin Building\Minecraft\plugins\root-territories\...\NationFoundingCommand.java` — `/nationfounding propose\|agree\|…` |
| Vote tips (+3 G) | `...\root-play\...\ProposalNotifyService.java` — `remindOnlinePlayers()`, `notifyOnJoin()`, `appendToVoteCommand()` |
| `/vote` only | `...\root-play\src\main\resources\plugin.yml` — no `proposal` command |

Discord (not MC) owns `/proposal` + `/proposals`.

---

## 2. How citizen proposals are submitted today

**Canonical create path:** `submitLegislationItem` → inserts `rootmc_legislation_items`, opens Discord #proposals thread.

```237:245:Web Files/rootmc-realm-api/src/rootmc-legislature.ts
export async function submitLegislationItem(
  env: LegislatureEnv,
  params: {
    discordUserId: string;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    category: string;
  },
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; detail: string; itemId?: string }>
```

Eligibility: `requireEligibleProposer()` (linked MC, ≥1h power, terms).

| Surface | Hook |
|---|---|
| Web | `POST /api/governance/proposals` → `handleGovernanceWebRoutes` → `submitLegislationItem` — `rootmc-governance-web.ts` ~L458–492 |
| UI | `Web Files\rootmc-web\public\governance\submit\index.html` |
| Discord `/proposal submit` | `handleProposalSlashCommand` — `rootmc-community-proposals.ts` ~L881; sub `submit` ~L927–940 |
| Discord `/proposals` | Registered in `scripts\discord-register-rootmc-commands.mjs` (`name: "proposal"` + `"proposals"`) |
| Staff poll (not citizen pipeline) | `createCommunityProposal(env, { title, description, days, createdByDiscordId, kind?, … })` — `rootmc-community-proposals.ts` ~L328 |

`createCommunityProposal` opens a **Council poll** (forum/#voting). Citizen items become polls later via weekly bill compile (`compileWeeklyBill`).

---

## 3. Ava / Grok proposal synthesis

**Ava does not call `submitLegislationItem` / `createCommunityProposal`.**

| Piece | Role |
|---|---|
| `rootmc-ava\src\classify.mjs` | FEATURE intent → “draft proposal outline… needs vote” |
| `rootmc-ava\src\pipeline.mjs` | `createJob(...)` for features; no API submit |
| `rootmc-ava\src\jobQueue.mjs` → `createJob` | Local plan via `writeProposalPlan` |
| `rootmc-ava\src\uploads.mjs` | `writeProposalPlan({ proposalId, title, body })`, `proposalPlanTemplate(...)` |
| Scripts | Manual Discord forum posts (`scripts\catchup-snappy.mjs`, `full-update-post.mjs`, …) |
| Votes only | `governanceClient.mjs` → `castTextVote` → `POST /api/governance/votes/:id` |

**Grok formalization (API, not Ava):**

```60:64:Web Files/rootmc-realm-api/src/rootmc-proposal-synthesis.ts
export async function synthesizeLegislationItem(
  env: ProposalSynthesisEnv,
  itemId: string,
  opts: { postToThread?: boolean } = {},
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; detail: string; messageCount?: number }>
```

- Merges original + Discord thread → `synthesized_description` via `callGrokJsonObject`
- Also: `synthesizePendingItemsForWeek`, bill-level synthesis in same file
- Triggered from legislature weekly compile (`rootmc-legislature.ts` imports synthesis)

No free-text → formal PROP pipeline for in-game messages yet.

---

## 4. Player → Server Reserve Gold

`RootMcTreasuryService` has **no** `acceptDonation`. Player→Reserve is on root-economy:

| Layer | Signature |
|---|---|
| Command | `PayCommand` — `/pay reserve <amount>` → confirm → `plugin.donateToReserve(...)` |
| Plugin API | `RootEconomyPlugin.donateToReserve(UUID, String, double)` |
| Treasury | `TreasuryManager.acceptDonation(UUID, String, double)` |
| Store | `EconomyStore.creditReserveDonation(donorUuid, donorName, amount, treasuryUuid, treasuryName, ledger)` — ledger `DONATION` |

Reserve → player (vote reward path): API queues transfer from `TOWNY_SERVER_UUID`; Claims applies via `EconomyCollector` + vault / `payVoteReward`.

3G first vote (already done):

- `GOVERNANCE_VOTE_REWARD_G = 3` — `rootmc-community-proposals.ts` L65
- `queueGovernanceVoteReward(...)` — idempotent id `govvote-{prop}-{uuid}`
- Called from `castProposalVote` only when `!isAva && isFirstVote` (~L622–634)
- In-game tips: `ProposalNotifyService` + `GET /api/governance/polls` / `proposal_vote_reward_g: 3`

---

## 5. In-game proposal submit API — **no**

Server-auth ingame patterns exist (`/api/rootmc/ingame-feedback`, `ingame-ask`, …) but **nothing** submits legislation.

Read-only governance from MC:

- `CloudApiClient.fetchGovernanceVotingPower(uuid)` → `/api/realm/minecraft/governance/voting-power`
- `CloudApiClient.fetchOpenGovernancePolls()` → `GET /api/governance/polls`

`POST /api/governance/proposals` requires **web Discord session**, not server auth — unusable from the plugin as-is.

---

## Best hook points for `/proposal <message>` (64G → Reserve → formal PROP)

1. **Command (root-play)**  
   Add `proposal` next to `/vote` in `plugin.yml` + new command class beside `VoteCommand`. Soft-depend Root-Economy + RootMC. Reuse `ProposalNotifyService` patterns for messaging.

2. **Charge 64G**  
   ```java
   RootEconomyPlugin / bridge → donateToReserve(playerUuid, name, 64.0)
   ```
   Same path as `/pay reserve` (no tx tax). Refund on API failure if charge-first.

3. **New server-auth API** (mirror `rootmc-ingame-feedback.ts`)  
   e.g. `POST /api/rootmc/ingame-proposal`  
   Body: `{ uuid, username, message, category? }`  
   - Resolve Discord via link table  
   - Optional: Grok title/description from free text (new helper next to `synthesizeLegislationItem`, or light `callGrokJsonObject`)  
   - Call `submitLegislationItem(env, { discordUserId, title, description, category })`  
   - Return `{ ok, item_id, url }`  
   Wire in `realm-router.ts` like other `handleRootMcIngame*`.

4. **Plugin HTTP**  
   `CloudApiClient` method + server credentials (same as other `/api/rootmc/*` posts).

5. **Keep 3G vote reward**  
   No change — already in `castProposalVote` → `queueGovernanceVoteReward`. Don’t double-pay.

6. **Ava optional later**  
   Not required for v1; Ava’s job/plan path is separate. Formal citizen PROP = `submitLegislationItem` only.

**Note:** `submitLegislationItem` still requires linked Discord + eligibility + terms. In-game flow should fail cleanly with verify/terms URLs if those are missing (after refunding 64G).
